|game_text=If His Destiny on table, deploy on table. Your personal Force generation = 2. Once per turn, may ▼ a mobile docking bay. Your total power everywhere is +1 for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy (limit +2). [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=The Players Committee changed “Unless Wokling on table, your total Force generation is +1” to “Your personal Force generation = 2,” and added the Personal Force icon. A power bonus for occupying Endor or Death Star II battlegrounds replaced Luke’s once-per-game relocation. The [[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)|Set 22 original]] preserves the earlier wording.
